title: Tiny, cute watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='canGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5bc8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a8fbf'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='spoutGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6ad4ef'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2196c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Handle (back) -->
  <path d='M50 32 Q50 14 68 14 Q86 14 86 32' fill='none' stroke='#7ae0f5' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Main body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='url(#canGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#8ee8fa' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='54' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#a8f0ff' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Top opening / rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='6' fill='#3db8d8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#8ee8fa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='9' ry='3.5' fill='#1a6a8a'/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d='M74 55 L90 36 L93 39 L77 58 Z' fill='url(#spoutGrad)' stroke='#8ee8fa' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Spout rose head -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#7ae0f5' transform='rotate(-40 92 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#c3f3ff' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-40 92 36)'/>
  <!-- Rose holes -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='35' r='1' fill='#1a6a8a'/>
  <circle cx='93' cy='34' r='1' fill='#1a6a8a'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='1' fill='#1a6a8a'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='37' r='1' fill='#1a6a8a'/>

  <!-- Water drops -->
  <path d='M88 44 Q89 48 87 49 Q85 48 86 44 Q87 42 88 44Z' fill='#9ff0ff'/>
  <path d='M92 46 Q93 50 91 51 Q89 50 90 46 Q91 44 92 46Z' fill='#9ff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='47' r='1.8' fill='#9ff0ff'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='42' r='1.4' fill='#9ff0ff'/>

  <!-- Cute face on body -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='64' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#0e4a63'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='64' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#0e4a63'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='63' r='1.1' fill='#e8ffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='63' r='1.1' fill='#e8ffff'/>

  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='70' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='70' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 71 Q50 75 54 71' fill='none' stroke='#0e4a63' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
